name: xmas-tree-3d
description: 3D Christmas tree with three.js, deployed on Cloudflare Workers (lite + guestbook)

scripts.dev:lite: node scripts/build.mjs lite && wrangler dev -c lite/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.dev:guestbook: node scripts/build.mjs guestbook && wrangler dev -c guestbook/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:lite: node scripts/build.mjs lite && wrangler deploy -c lite/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:guestbook: node scripts/build.mjs guestbook && wrangler deploy -c guestbook/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:init: wrangler d1 execute xmas-guestbook --remote --file guestbook/schema.sql -c guestbook/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:init:local: wrangler d1 execute xmas-guestbook --local --file guestbook/schema.sql -c guestbook/wrangler.jsonc
